hosts.description: List of FTP/HTTP/BitTorrent server aliases. Each alias creates a convenient command to jump to a pre-configured session.

name.description: Short alias name (e.g., 'backup', 'cdn') for use with 'lftp alias_name' in shell

password.description: Optional password for authentication (⚠️ store in secure file permissions or use lftp's keyring if possible)

port.description: Optional port (0 means default for protocol)

remote_dir.description: Starting directory on the remote server (e.g., 'pub/data')

sessions.description: List of named session configurations to be used at runtime (e.g., with 'lftp -e "source session_name"'). Each session can override global defaults.

timeout.description: Network timeout in seconds for this session

passive.description: Enable or disable FTP passive mode

ssl.description: Allow use of FTP over TLS/SSL

ssl_force.description: Force FTP over TLS/SSL (abort if server doesn't support it)

parallel_num.description: Number of parallel connections to use by default for mirroring

net_timeout.description: Global network timeout (seconds). Shorter timeouts fail fast; longer ones help with unreliable networks.

net_reconnect_interval.description: Time to wait before attempting to reconnect after a disconnection.

ftp_passive_mode.description: Enable FTP passive mode (required behind most firewalls/NAT).

ftp_ssl_allow.description: Allow FTP/SSL connections. Disable only in isolated, trusted environments.

ftp_ssl_force.description: Require FTP/SSL; abort if not supported (strict security).

ftp_ssl_data_protect.description: Encrypt data channel (in addition to control) when using FTP/SSL.

http_use_proxy.description: Use HTTP proxy (requires proxy_host and proxy_port).

http_proxy_host.description: HTTP proxy hostname or IP (only used if http_use_proxy is true).

http_proxy_port.description: HTTP proxy port (e.g., 8080). 0 means no proxy.

mirror_retry_timeout.description: Time to wait before retrying failed mirror operations (seconds).

mirror_connect_timeout.description: Timeout (seconds) for establishing each mirror connection.
